name: Ossify DBM Cortical Fiber Bone Graft 0.5cc jar

It is configured both by itself and with the addition of 1-1.5mm mineralized cancellous particles. This unique allograft provides an ideal scaffold for bone formation with its extremely high surface area and its optimum shape conforming properties, making it highly osteoconductive. In addition, it has great osteoinductive potential due to the specialized demineralized process. The graft hydrates very uniformly with PRP, blood or saline for maximum handling. It can be used in a variety of surgical applications, including socket grafting, GBR, sinus augmentation, and other bone grafting procedures.
